name: markdown-accept-extensions
body: The markdown frontend must accept the markdown extension set (.md, .markdown) and emit, for each accepted file, a Module node for its directory — FQN = the directory's absolute path, the path-derived collision-free module identity (see markdown-sections-as-symbols) — and a File node whose FQN is the absolute path, extension retained — never dropping the file (all-code-included: filtering is by code_type, not by omission). The accepted set is an open design point for hybrid extensions such as .mdx (see the open-points note). AC: a repo containing .md and .markdown files produces a module and a file node for each, with no file absent from the graph.
